title: Topic file of one video (motion-studio video)
description: Everything `motion-studio video` needs to make one video without a hand step: the script (a scenes.json), its fact check, the casting and the gate window. Paths are relative to the topic file.

job.description: Name of the job folder in the work dir and of every output (<job>.<lang>.mp4).

topic.description: One line on what the video is about (for the report).

scenes.description: The script: a scenes.json with the narration of every scene. Copied into the job folder as scenes.json.

factcheck.description: The fact check of that narration (the gate's format). Copied into the job folder as factcheck.md.

assets.description: Extra files to copy next to the job's scenes.json (paths relative to the scenes file's folder), e.g. a module a Manim script imports. Files named by visuals and audio are copied anyway.

languages.description: Languages to make (default: every language of the scenes file).

cast.description: Casting per language: a preset of the voices config, and optionally which of its guest voices to use (default: the first).

voices.description: The voices config (default: the nearest voices.json in the topic file's folder or a parent folder).

stand_in.description: true: when the narrator's reference clip is not set, read the narrator's lines with the preset's stand-in voice instead of stopping (same as --stand-in).

gate.description: Length window of the gate in seconds (default 600-1200). A changed window is for samples and tests: stage-upload refuses its gate report.
